parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity or expression; anti-discrimination and hate-crime provisions cover gender identity (though enforcement is weak), pride events have run annually under police protection, and no visitor-facing restriction is documented on borders, documents or facilities — so no universal-exposure measure applies. What pulls it down is documented societal hostility with thin recourse: 20+ unsanctioned attacks forced an LGBT centre to close, a 2024 capital raid in which officers allegedly assaulted and sexually harassed LGBT people produced no sanction, and reports record continuing significant intolerance and violence plus rule-of-law weaknesses (activist arrests, smear campaigns). Social attitudes are markedly hostile (57% call homosexuality a disease). Much of the dossier (marriage, adoption, employment, HRT coverage) is resident-facing and not rated. With no documented targeting of trans visitors specifically and remedies only partly demonstrated, the visitor exposure is documented hostility with inadequate remedy — Elevated Risk.
